requirement: A new user shall be able to create a unique username when registering for an Acountabilibuddy account.
source: your own decision — I believe that creating an account and logging into the system will be the best and easiest way to assign privileges to users as well as assign rank and role.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-01; all expected results must pass

requirement: A new user shall be able to create a password that meets the defined security criteria when registering for an Acountabilibuddy account.
source: your own decision — I believe that creating an account and logging into the system will be the best and easiest way to assign privileges to users as well as assign rank and role.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-02; all expected results must pass

requirement: All users of Acountabilibuddy will be able to change their unique user account password.
source: your own decision — I believe that the ability to change a password will be a quality of life feature that will greatly help the users feel secure in their ability to recover their accounts in the event of forgetting or losing password.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-03; all expected results must pass

requirement: A registered user will be able to log in using their username and password and in order to access the features authorized for their assigned role/rank.
source: your own decision — Requiring an account and login credentials is essential in maintaining security within Acountabilibuddy and protecting private information stored within user accounts, chat history, and privileges
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-04; all expected results must pass

requirement: A registered user will be able to log out from the system which will end the authenticated session started at login
source: your own decision — Allowing users to logout will reduce strain on the program servers and promote better security due to closing inactive user authenticated sessions.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-05; all expected results must pass

requirement: The system shall prevent the creation of an account when the requested username is already assigned to another account.
source: your own decision — preventing the creation of multiple accounts using the same username will prevent technical errors and data loss issues
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-ACCT-06; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to create large groups based on the unit utilizing the system

measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-UNIT-01; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to add existing Acountabilibuddy users to already existing units.
source: your own decision — The ability to add users to already existing unit groups will be required because in the military new soldiers are always being transferred in and out of existing units.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-UNIT-02; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to remove existing Acountabilibuddy users from already existing units.

measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-UNIT-03; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to make existing Acountabilibuddy users administrators of already existing units.
source: your own decision — The ability to make users administrators of existing unit groups will be required because multiple leaders within a military unit may need administrative permissions to manage unit members, communication, calendar events, and accountability.

measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-UNIT-04; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to remove administrator permissions from existing Acountabilibuddy users within already existing units.
source: your own decision — The ability to remove administrator permissions from existing unit members will be required because military personnel may transfer out of leadership positions or responsibilities while remaining members of the unit.
design_element: Unit role editor + membership authorization service
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-UNIT-05; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to create group chats for existing Acountabilibuddy units.
source: your own decision — The ability to create group chats will be required because military units may need separate communication channels for different groups of personnel within the same unit.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-CHAT-01; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to add existing Acountabilibuddy users who are members of the unit to already existing group chats.
source: your own decision — The ability to add users to existing group chats will be required because military personnel may be transferred into existing units and need to be added to established communication groups.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-CHAT-02; all expected results must pass

requirement: Administrative users shall be able to remove existing Acountabilibuddy users from already existing group chats.
source: your own decision — The ability to remove users from existing group chats will be required because military personnel may be transferred out of units or no longer require access to specific communication groups.
measurement_method: Execute every Given/when/then acceptance criterion under FR-CHAT-03; all expected results must pass

requirement: Users shall be able to send messages in group chats that they are members of.

requirement: The system shall maintain a history of messages sent within group chats and allow authorized members to view previous messages.

requirement: p95 server response time: ≤ 1.5 s under this condition: 20 sequential authenticated GETs of a unit page containing 50 members, 100 messages, and 25 events from the deployed service after one warm-up
source: Section 6 — Performance
measurement_method: Seed the stated dataset; run `python code/measure_http.py --url URL --requests 20`; save its p95 output.

requirement: HTML response size: ≤ 500 KiB under this condition: Same seeded unit-page request, excluding separately loaded CSS
source: Section 6 — Performance
measurement_method: Save the response with `curl`; record `Length`/byte count and confirm the threshold.

requirement: Successful test runs: 10 of 10 consecutive runs under this condition: Clean test environment using pinned development requirements
source: Section 6 — Reliability
measurement_method: Run the pytest command ten times; record each exit code, all of which must be zero.

requirement: Recovery result after database interruption: No data loss among acknowledged writes; `/health` returns 200 within 5 minutes under this condition: Restart an Atlas test cluster or disconnect/reconnect a local MongoDB after creating a uniquely named event
source: Section 6 — Reliability
measurement_method: Record event ID, outage responses, recovery time, and confirm the same event after reconnection.

requirement: Unauthorized unit reads/writes: 0 successful requests under this condition: Anonymous, authenticated non-member, member, leader, and owner exercise every unit-scoped route
source: Section 6 — Security
measurement_method: Run the role-permission pytest cases; every disallowed request must be 302, 403, or 404 and create no record.

requirement: Accepted state-changing requests lacking a valid CSRF token: 0 under this condition: Every POST route is called once with no token and once with a modified token
source: Section 6 — Security
measurement_method: Parameterized Flask-client test must return 400 for every request and show no database change.

requirement: Committed secrets or plaintext passwords: 0 findings under this condition: Git-tracked files plus one newly registered test user
source: Section 6 — Security
design_element: environment configuration + password hashing + dependency audit
measurement_method: Run `git grep` for configured secret patterns and inspect the user document; run `pip-audit -r implementation/requirements.txt`; record zero secrets/plaintext credentials and resolve any known high/critical vulnerability before release.

requirement: Executable markup from user-controlled message/name fields: 0 executions under this condition: Submit `<script>alert(1)</script>` in every displayed text field
source: Section 6 — Security
measurement_method: Automated response assertions require escaped markup; manually open each affected view and confirm no alert or injected element.

requirement: Data fields collected outside the inventory below: 0 under this condition: Registration and normal member/leader workflows
source: Section 6 — Privacy
design_element: MongoDB collection schemas + documented data inventory
measurement_method: Compare MongoDB document keys from a seeded end-to-end run with the inventory; document and approve any difference before merge.

requirement: Time to complete a verified deletion request: ≤ 7 calendar days, with 0 matching application records afterward under this condition: Prototype user makes a written request and proves control of the username
source: Section 6 — Privacy
measurement_method: Admin runs the documented deletion procedure, searches all collections by user ID/name, and records date, query results, and any provider-backup limitation.

requirement: Critical/serious automated accessibility findings: 0 under this condition: Register, login, dashboard, and populated unit pages at desktop and 390 px viewport
source: Section 6 — Accessibility
measurement_method: Run axe DevTools on each page; save dated results and resolve every critical/serious finding.

requirement: Core tasks completable using keyboard only: 5 of 5: register, sign in, post message, respond to event, sign out under this condition: Chrome at 100% zoom with mouse/touch unused
source: Section 6 — Accessibility
design_element: semantic HTML forms + global focus styles
measurement_method: Start at address bar; use Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space, record pass/fail, and confirm visible focus and logical order.

requirement: First-attempt task completion: ≥ 4 of 5 representative users complete ≥ 4 of 5 core tasks without coaching, each task in ≤ 2 minutes under this condition: Fresh accounts and a seeded unit on a phone or laptop
source: Section 6 — Usability
measurement_method: Give the five task prompts without procedural hints; time attempts and record completion/errors, not participant names.

requirement: Invalid-input responses that explain a corrective action: 100% of the 8 documented invalid-input cases under this condition: Weak password, duplicate username, bad administrator token, unknown member, missing field, overlong field, naive event time, invalid attendance value
source: Section 6 — Usability
measurement_method: Execute the checklist; response must reject the write and supply an actionable message or documented HTTP error.

requirement: Automated regression status and runtime: 100% pass in ≤ 60 s under this condition: Fresh virtual environment on the course-development laptop
source: Section 6 — Maintainability
measurement_method: Install pinned files and run `python -m pytest implementation/tests -q`; record count, time, and exit code.

requirement: Traceability validation findings: 0 under this condition: Every requirements change before merge
source: Section 6 — Maintainability
measurement_method: Run `python code/check-traceability.py`; it must exit 0 with no missing IDs, blanks, duplicates, or unknown requirement references.

requirement: Successful supported-environment smoke tests: 2 of 2 environments under this condition: Windows 11 local Python 3.12 and Render Linux using the same dependency pins
source: Section 6 — Portability
measurement_method: In each environment register/login, create a unit/event, and record attendance
